inventoryNotes: Official USBE directory reconciled with PCSD, UDOT and provider campus lists. Earlier inventory coverage remains incomplete. USBE opening dates identify schools, not proof of campus continuity. Mailing-only Provo entries with official physical addresses in American Fork and Lindon are excluded.

ugrc-addresses.evidence: Retained exact-address points in private research campus-address-points.json.

phs-coordinate.evidence: NCES CCD coordinate corroborated against NCES official current campus address and school history.

slate-programs.evidence: Three physical teaching sites, Slate Canyon, Oak Springs and Vantage Point.

treeside-history.evidence: 2019 State Street campus and 2025-26 East Bay campus evidence and UGRC points.
